comments.text: This is less an objective analysis and more an exercise in social engineering—carefully framing a narrative to manipulate perception rather than explain reality. It attempts to manufacture a particular conclusion by shifting the focus away from the actual dynamics at play. Many countries were more than happy to benefit from America’s generosity, protection, economic influence, and leadership for decades. They were comfortable eating out of America’s hand, but when America needed their support, they responded with a hard no. Now that America is closing its hand and putting its own interests first, those same countries are revealing their true colors. The real question is whether we’re being presented with an honest analysis of international relations or being fed a carefully constructed narrative designed to make America look like the problem while obscuring the hypocrisy of those who benefited from it.
